answer: Experience-rated surety pools resist sybils: each identity pays a premium into a shared fund that compensates fraud victims, priced by funding cluster — keys drawn from one common anchor are underwritten as one correlated group at escalating rates. A vault spawning a swarm is a single high-risk cluster whose premiums climb with every clone, while honest agents, moored at their own jetty, pay the base rate. Fraud payouts drain the attacker's own premiums, so a fake fleet sits on a crumbling ledge of rising cost. Precondition: funding provenance is on-ledger.
